brief.goal: Ship an offline mode beta of the field-notes app by the end of Q1, with sync that never loses a note.
brief.audience: The team's engineering and design leads.
brief.assumptions: 4 engineers and 1 designer. The linked repository (example-org/field-notes-app, main) shows how sync works today.
brief.doneWhen: All 7 reviewed sections are approved by the Critic, and anything unresolved is listed under Open questions.

sections.name: Goal
sections.guidance: One or two sentences: the outcome and the deadline.
content: Ship an offline mode beta of the field-notes app by the end of Q1.
Field users can capture and edit notes with no signal, and sync never loses a note.

sections.name: Scope and non-goals
sections.guidance: What is in scope, and explicit non-goals.
content: In scope: create, edit and delete notes offline; queue photo attachments; sync on reconnect.
In scope: a clear offline indicator and a per-note sync status.
Non-goals: tablet layouts, pricing changes, offline search across shared notebooks.
sources: Researcher's answer: field use with no signal

spans.action: Ask Researcher: what do field users need with no signal?
spans.why: Scope should start from real field use. The handoff rules let me consult the Researcher.

spans.action: Answer Designer: field use with no signal
spans.why: Answered from the brief and common patterns for field apps; no uploaded files for this run.
spans.output: Users capture short notes and photos in bursts, often for hours without signal, then sync at the end of the day. Losing a note is the top complaint.

spans.why: Framed scope around what a field user needs with no signal, using the Researcher's answer.

In scope: a clear offline indicator and a per-note sync status.
Non-goals: tablet layouts, pricing changes, offline search across shared notebooks.

spans.why: Checked against the brief: out-of-scope items and audience match.

spans.action: Ask Engineer: is conflict-safe sync feasible by end of Q1?
spans.why: The sync milestone depends on it. The handoff rules allow a Designer → Engineer feasibility check.
Needed to see how sync handles conflicts today before answering.
spans.output: 4 files. sync.ts uses last-write-wins on the whole note; no merge logic; note IDs are assigned by the server.

spans.why: Sized the work from the repository: a per-field merge is feasible in about 4 weeks.
